The script compiles and runs without errors. Changes made to `scripts/player.gd`:

- Added `@export_range(0.0, 1.0) var friction = 0.1` and `@export_range(0.0, 1.0) var acceleration = 0.25`
- Cached input as `dir` variable via `Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")`
- When `dir != 0`, velocity.x lerps toward `dir * speed` using `acceleration`
- When idle (`dir == 0`), velocity.x lerps toward `0.0` using `friction`
- Gravity, `move_and_slide()`, and jump gated on `is_on_floor()` all preserved
